dependencies.reason: Registers commands on its toolio shell and uses its envelope, exit codes, input resolution, forge construction, DryRunForge/ErrDryRun, needs_human resume, RunDir/OpenRunDir/Record/Ledger and --schema goldens; this spec adds a run-time forge constructor to toolio.
Uses checks.FileView for path resolution and the repository map, repomap.Build for the brief's map, and the guard policy that allows af triage brief/submit to a brain.
Plugs the triage submission Kind and validator into its submission protocol and submit command factory, and runs briefs through brain.Execute with the local box and the scripted and agentkit brains.
